title: The Quiet Portrait
author: Edmund Thackeray
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
